subject: AgentUtility x402-list scope drift
decision: Do not attribute x402-list service-level reliability, latency, price, volume or buyer telemetry to AgentUtility structured-search endpoints unless the monitored endpoint is explicitly present in the source endpoint inventory.

observations.observed: The current page exposes 9 monitored endpoints, none of which is a structured-search endpoint. It reports 100% 30d unpaid-402 handshake uptime, 1615ms p95, 862ms average and 2700 checks at service level, and explicitly says the measurement is the unpaid 402 handshake, not the paid call. Current on-chain volume and distinct buyers are shown as unmeasured, not zero.
AgentUtility's current first-party site states 799 live x402 endpoints across 18 clusters, materially broader than the 9 endpoints represented on the x402-list service page.

implication: The x402-list AgentUtility page is useful as third-party evidence for the subset it actually monitors, but it is not evidence that AgentUtility search-web/search endpoints inherit those telemetry values. Earlier seller-level demand/settlement figures must be treated as time-bounded observations and not carried forward when the current source reports those metrics unmeasured.
nextGate: For AgentUtility structured search, require endpoint-specific schema plus a fresh raw unpaid 402 for that exact endpoint; only paid identical-task outcomes may populate deterministic acceptance, paid latency or effective cost per acceptable result.
